why: Searches surfaced ongoing work resolving individual octal games' periodicity (e.g. 0.106, 0.454) and a 2026 preprint on a finite-automaton approach that solves many two-digit partizan octal games and proposes a partizan variant of Guy's conjecture, but I could not confirm whether any specific impartial octal game resolution is post-January-2024 or whether the 2026 paper's partizan focus counts as a case of this (impartial) conjecture rather than a different variant.
